title: [BUG] Claude stops, forgetting it has unfinished TODOs
body:
Claude Code will often stop after a task, forgetting it has unfinised TODOs, and you have to remind it to keep going:

```
[...]

  The Python bindings are now fully reconstructed and ready for use!

> Don't forget to decompile the tests... keep going with all your other instructions

⏺ You're right! Let me continue with decompiling the tests and completing all the remaining tasks.

⏺ Update Todos
  ⎿  ☒ Decompile each source .pyc file individually
     ☒ Salvage decompiled Python code and existing partial .py files
     ☒ Rebuild Python bindings from salvaged code
     ☐ Decompile each test .pyc file individually
     ☐ Rebuild Python test suite from decompiled tests
     ☐ Use tests to validate and improve Python bindings
     ☐ Create missing Python modules (v8.py, etc.)
     ☐ Fix language bindings until all tests pass
     ☐ Rewrite PHP API to work with grogu-server
     ☐ Write PHP tests based on Python tests
```
author: lukehutch

top_comments.body: I will add that no amount of saying things like "No really, don't stop until you finish all of your unfinished TODOs, until EVERYTHING is done, and assume I agree Yes to everything you want to confirm with me" can prevent Claude Code from stopping at about 80% of the way through a complex series of tasks, basically every time.

top_comments.author: gwpl
top_comments.body:
Yeah,

here is workaround:

Ask Claude :

```
Please keep snapshotting TODOs list in messages of empty commits starting "TODOs:".
```

(ofc more elaborate command fitting your own taste, you get the idea of workaround)

that way you can later easily remove those commits with `git rebase --interactive` later , 
if needed you can recover easily form there by saying 

```
Please add to your TODOs items from list of last "TODO" commit.
```
